parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select a region for the Management Center based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of a member. This parameter allows an administrator to switch to the perspective of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.
